# Jersey DPJL 2018 — Implementation Checklist for Applications & Organisations

## Governance & Accountability
- [ ] Appoint appropriate accountability (DPO where required)
- [ ] Maintain records of processing activities (RoPA)
- [ ] Data Protection policy and procedures documented
- [ ] Staff training and awareness programme

## Lawful Processing & Transparency
- [ ] Identify lawful basis for each processing activity
- [ ] Privacy notices / transparency information at collection point
- [ ] Consent mechanisms (where used) are granular, freely given, recorded, and withdrawable

## Data Minimisation & Security
- [ ] Data minimisation by design
- [ ] Appropriate technical & organisational security measures (encryption, access controls, logging)
- [ ] Pseudonymisation / anonymisation considered

## Individual Rights
- [ ] Process for handling SARs, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, objections
- [ ] Time limits tracked (1 month standard)
- [ ] Identity verification procedures

## High-Risk Processing
- [ ] DPIA process for high-risk processing (large scale, vulnerable data subjects, new technologies, automated decision-making, special category data)
- [ ] Prior consultation with JOIC where required

## Processors & International Transfers
- [ ] Written contracts with processors containing required DPJL clauses
- [ ] Transfer impact assessments + appropriate safeguards (or adequacy/derogation)

## Breach Management
- [ ] Breach detection, logging, and investigation process
- [ ] Notification to JOIC without undue delay (72 hours where feasible)
- [ ] Communication to affected data subjects where high risk

## Registration
- [ ] Check and complete any required registration with the Authority

## Retention & Disposal
- [ ] Retention schedules justified and implemented
- [ ] Secure deletion / anonymisation at end of retention

## Testing & Review
- [ ] Regular compliance audits / reviews
- [ ] DPIA and risk assessments kept up to date
- [ ] Incident response testing

Use in conjunction with the main skill and official guidance from jerseyoic.org.
